threads.body: The YAML schema produced here changed from `libraries: { <group>: [ ... ] }` to `libraries: [ ... ]`. There are in-repo consumers that still assume `libraries` is a map (e.g., `instrumentation-docs/.../auditors/SuppressionListAuditor.parseInstrumentationList`), which will now return an empty instrumentation list and break the audit behavior/tests. Please update those parsers (and their tests) to handle `libraries` as a list of instrumentation objects, and verify any other readers of `docs/instrumentation-list.yaml` are updated for the new file_format/schema.

Bumping `file_format` to 0.5 makes this a breaking change for any tooling that reads `docs/instrumentation-list.yaml`. The repo currently has `docs/instrumentation-list.yaml` committed with `file_format: 0.4`, and at least one auditor parses the file. Please ensure the generated `docs/instrumentation-list.yaml` is updated in this PR (or the build/audit tooling is adjusted to regenerate it) so the committed artifact and consumers stay in sync with the new 0.5 schema.
